description: Local source and documentation snapshot index for the seismotools packages.

phase_picking.implementation: Local TRACE-1.1 phase_picking model package, SeisBench utilities dependency
phase_picking.license_status: No standalone license file found in local model folder; preserve source notices and verify upstream redistribution terms.

gamma.license_status: No standalone license file found in local source; redistribution terms need upstream verification.

nonlinloc.implementation: NLL7.00 native binaries plus the project-local Nonlinlocpy Python package; interface/run.py (v2, single event; location_method switch) and interface/locate.py (v3, catalog locator, project code in nonlinlocpy/catalog.py)

hypodd.implementation: Local hypoDD distribution plus executed stage-53 src/hypoDD and include files
hypodd.license_status: Preserve bundled README, manual and source notices; no new project license applied.

match_and_locate.implementation: MatchLocate2 2.0 (Miao Zhang) from MatchLocate2-master.zip, commit bac5ccb, archive sha256 543b6bc9...ad19; built with local patches source/patches/0001-0007
match_and_locate.license_status: GPL-3.0 (source/upstream/LICENSE); preserve notices. Local patches are distributed as separate patch files.

variants: S on two horizontals (N/E or 1/2), averaged curves
cross_correlation.license_status: Project code; no third-party source bundled.

pyocto.implementation: PyOcto 0.1.9 (Jannes Münchmeyer) from the PyPI sdist (sha256 6f985b92...6d19), C++ core built locally with patch 0001 into runtime/build/site; adapter interface/run.py (interface version 1)

files.local_change: 2026-10-26 local change: location_method and grid_center settings (default grid spans the station footprint)

validation.scope: Integrity, offline local imports, strict CPU weight loading and native compilation only; no scientific rerun or migration of expert callers.
validation.documentation_update: Supplemental documents checked against their local sources; notebook source cells preserved with outputs cleared. Runtime implementation and weights unchanged.

documentation_scope.gamma: Local GaMMA README, curated docs/core usage guides, and runnable examples; historical generated pages, raw RAG copies, source tests/notebooks, retrieval descriptions and support figures excluded.
documentation_scope.nonlinloc: Installed native source and binaries plus the copied Nonlinlocpy Python package and documentation.
documentation_scope.phase_picking: Original model modules, selected expert weights, top-level inference examples and inference tutorial; excludes backup wrappers, unused weights and agent/RAG notebooks.
documentation_scope.hypodd: Previously copied native distribution source/manual and executed native source/header; excludes optional hypodd_runner/FDTCC/backup implementations not used by the native expert branch.
